pulseq_element.pulseq.script:
# Pulseq sequence file
# Created by PyPulseq
# PARAMETERS_JSON_START
# {
#   "gradX_amp":    { "type": "float", "default": 4.7, "min": -40.0, "max": 40.0, "step": 0.1, "unit": "mT/m", "pulseq_value": 250000,  "pulseq_unit": "Hz/m", "description":"gradient amplitude in x direction" },
#   "gradY_amp":    { "type": "float", "default": 4.0, "min": -40.0, "max": 40.0, "step": 0.1, "unit": "mT/m", "pulseq_value": 200000,  "pulseq_unit": "Hz/m", "description":"gradient amplitude in y direction" },
#   "adc_phase": {
#     "type": "float", "default": 0.0, "min": 0.0, "max": 360.0, "step": 1,
#     "unit": "deg", "pulseq_value": 0, "pulseq_unit": "rad", "description": "adc phase"
#   }
# }
# PARAMETERS_JSON_END

[VERSION]
major 1
minor 4
revision 2

[DEFINITIONS]
AdcRasterTime 1e-07 
BlockDurationRaster 1e-05 
FOV 0.2 0.2 0.002 
GradientRasterTime 0.0001 
Name gre 
RadiofrequencyRasterTime 1e-06 
TotalDuration 0.00348 

# Format of blocks:
# NUM DUR RF  GX  GY  GZ  ADC  EXT
[BLOCKS]
  1 100   0   1   2   0  0  0
  2 148   0   3   0   0  1  0
  3 100   0   1   4   0  0  0

# Format of trapezoid gradients:
# id amplitude rise flat fall delay
# ..      Hz/m   us   us   us    us
[TRAP]
 1    {int(-gradX_amp*215625/250000)} 200  600 200   0
 2    {int(-gradY_amp)} 200  600 200   0
 3    {int(gradX_amp)} 100 1280 100   0
 4    {int(gradY_amp)} 200  600 200   0

# Format of ADC events:
# id num dwell delay freq phase
# ..  ..    ns    us   Hz   rad
[ADC]
1 64 20000 100 0 {adc_phase}
